card.name: Qualifier words in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Modifier or word-ending pieces in dosing and preparation instructions, such as 'required' before 'number', 'anticipated' before 'start', and 'equivalent' after a drug or dose.

modes.label: Before an amount or quantity
modes.description: Adjective right after 'the' that leads into a number or amount in preparation steps.
modes.example: 2. Obtain the<< required>> number of AQNEURSA packets for

modes.label: Equivalence and conditional wording
modes.description: Words like 'equivalent', 'would' or 'shown' that qualify a dose or a requirement.

modes.label: Inside medical terms
modes.description: Ending pieces of longer words such as etiologies or inducers.
modes.example: exclude other eti<<ologies>>. Consider discontinuation of amlod
